description: This is a JavaScript source file that initializes a LightningJS application called 'App' and sets up key bindings for navigation.

methods.name: Blits.Launch
methods.description: Initializes and launches the LightningJS application with specified configuration.

calls: Blits.Launch(App, 'app', { w: 1280, h: 720, keys: { up: ['ArrowUp'], down: ['ArrowDown'], left: ['ArrowLeft'], right: ['ArrowRight'], enter: ['Enter', 'Space'], back: ['Escape', 'Backspace'] } })
